# Rudi UI public API

<!-- Generated by tool/generate_skill_reference.dart. Do not edit. -->

Package version: `0.5.0`

Source fingerprint: `6ae6b677d2584564`

This catalog lists the public top-level declarations exported by `package:rudi_ui/rudi_ui.dart`. Use it for discovery, then inspect the resolved package source for exact parameters and current behavior.

## `lib/src/app/rudi_app.dart`

- `RudiThemeMode` — Selects how `RudiApp` resolves light and dark themes.
- `RudiScrollBehavior` — Platform-aware scrolling without Android's legacy overscroll glow.
- `RudiApp` — A widgets-only application shell configured for Rudi UI.
- `RudiSystemUi` — Applies transparent system bars with icons matching the active Rudi theme. `RudiApp` installs this automatically. Apps using another application shell can wrap their content with this widget to get the same system UI styling.
- `RudiPage` — A responsive page surface with safe-area and readable-width handling.
- `RudiAppBar` — A safe-area-aware app bar for a `RudiPage`. The app bar owns the top system inset, so pair it with `RudiPage.safeAreaTop: false` when both share a page.
- `RudiBackButton` — A standard back action that pops the nearest navigator by default. Supply `onPressed` when cleanup or other work must happen before navigating.

## `lib/src/components/actions.dart`

- `RudiInteractionState` — Visual interaction state supplied by `RudiPressable`.
- `RudiPressableBuilder` — Builds the content of a `RudiPressable` from its interaction state.
- `RudiPressable` — A platform-neutral accessible interaction primitive.
- `RudiButtonVariant` — Visual variants supported by `RudiButton`.
- `RudiButton` — A labeled Rudi UI action button.
- `RudiIconButton` — An icon-only action button.
- `RudiHoldToConfirm` — A button that activates only after being held for `duration`.
- `RudiSwipeAction` — A horizontally swiped confirmation control.

## `lib/src/components/bottom_sheet.dart`

- `showRudiBottomSheet` — Opens a spring-driven Rudi bottom sheet.
- `RudiBottomSheet` — A reusable bottom-sheet shell for forms and actions.
- `RudiBottomSheetCloseButton` — Standard close action for a `RudiBottomSheet`.

## `lib/src/components/calendar.dart`

- `RudiCalendarDayState` — Visual state of a day in a `RudiCalendar`.
- `RudiCalendarMonthLabelBuilder` — Builds a localized label for a calendar month.
- `RudiCalendarDayStateBuilder` — Resolves the visual and interactive state of a calendar day.
- `RudiCalendarDaySemanticLabelBuilder` — Builds the full semantic label for a calendar day.
- `RudiCalendar` — An accessible, swipeable month calendar without Material dependencies. Formatting remains with the caller so month, weekday and accessibility labels can follow the app's localization setup without adding a dependency.

## `lib/src/components/dialog.dart`

- `showRudiDialog` — Shows a modal Rudi dialog.
- `RudiDialog` — A responsive modal dialog surface.

## `lib/src/components/feedback_views.dart`

- `RudiEmptyView` — A neutral empty-state presentation.
- `RudiErrorView` — A neutral error presentation with injected recovery actions.
- `RudiLoadingView` — A centered loading state with optional status copy.

## `lib/src/components/fields.dart`

- `RudiTextField` — A full-featured, widgets-only text input with Rudi styling.
- `RudiTextFormField` — A `Form` participant that renders a `RudiTextField`.
- `RudiNumberInput` — A bounded numeric stepper.

## `lib/src/components/floating_navigation.dart`

- `RudiFloatingNavigationBar` — Floating navigation with circular selection and an optional contextual action.

## `lib/src/components/icons.dart`

- `RudiGlyphType` — Built-in interface glyphs used by Rudi UI.
- `RudiGlyph` — A small, dependency-free Rudi interface glyph.

## `lib/src/components/navigation.dart`

- `RudiNavigationDestination` — A destination displayed by `RudiFloatingNavigationBar`.
- `RudiNavigationAction` — Contextual action displayed beside a floating navigation bar.

## `lib/src/components/overlays.dart`

- `RudiSnackVariant` — Semantic presentation used by a `RudiSnack`.
- `RudiSnack` — Immutable description of a transient Rudi message.
- `RudiMessengerController` — Programmatic controller for a `RudiMessenger`.
- `RudiMessenger` — Hosts transient messages above its child without Material's Scaffold.
- `RudiMessengerState` — Mutable state and imperative API for `RudiMessenger`.

## `lib/src/components/progress.dart`

- `RudiDurationLabelBuilder` — Creates a localized accessibility label for a duration value.
- `RudiLinearProgress` — A linear progress indicator with optional indeterminate animation.
- `RudiProgressRing` — A circular progress visualization.
- `RudiTickProgress` — A tick-based progress visualization.
- `RudiDurationRuler` — A scrollable ruler for selecting a bounded duration.

## `lib/src/components/settings.dart`

- `RudiSettingsSection` — A titled group of related settings or controls.
- `RudiSettingsTile` — A generic setting or preference row.
- `RudiOptionTile` — A selectable option row.
- `RudiExpandableControl` — A control that reveals additional content inline.
- `RudiSettingsGroup` — Separated rows with grouped outer corners, accent labels and bold titles.
- `RudiSwitchTile` — A setting row with one accessible toggle target and a draggable switch.

## `lib/src/components/tooltip.dart`

- `RudiTooltip` — A passive tooltip shown for hover, keyboard focus, or a long press. Unlike `RudiInfoTooltip`, tapping the child keeps activating the child.
- `RudiInfoTooltip` — A compact, anchored explanation opened from an information button.

## `lib/src/foundation/feedback.dart`

- `RudiFeedbackPolicy` — Controls optional tactile and audible feedback produced by Rudi UI.

## `lib/src/foundation/theme.dart`

- `RudiColorScheme` — Semantic colors used by every Rudi UI component.
- `RudiTextTheme` — Typography roles used by Rudi UI.
- `RudiThemeData` — Immutable configuration consumed by Rudi UI components.
- `RudiTheme` — Supplies `RudiThemeData` to descendant widgets.
- `AnimatedRudiTheme` — Animates changes between Rudi themes.
- `RudiThemeBuildContext` — Convenient access to the active Rudi theme.

## `lib/src/foundation/tokens.dart`

- `RudiSpacing` — Spacing values used throughout Rudi UI.
- `RudiRadii` — Corner radii used throughout Rudi UI.
- `RudiMotion` — Motion durations, curves, and spring behavior used by Rudi UI.
- `RudiBreakpoints` — Width breakpoints used for adaptive Rudi UI layouts.
